name: Tomachie
description: Send a schematic to Tomachie for test-point insertion and design review
description_full:
BEFORE INSTALLING: in KiCad open Preferences > Plugins and tick Enable KiCad API, then restart KiCad. KiCad ships with it off, and while it is off no plugin button appears.

Adds a button to the schematic editor that submits the open design to tomachie.com.

The plugin resolves the project, follows the sheet hierarchy, packages the schematic files and uploads them. You then choose the Design-for-Test options in your browser and start the analysis there. The results, including a design with test points inserted, are emailed to you.

The plugin performs no analysis itself and creates no job until you press Analyze on the website. Your schematic files are sent off your computer to tomachie.com; the agreement covering that is linked from the plugin's setup dialog.
